order_title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012
issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
product_scope: Information technology goods, servers, laptops, printers, power adapters
exemptions: Sample units imported for type testing up to 5 units per model
evidence_excerpt: No person shall manufacture or store for sale, import, sell or distribute goods specified in the Schedule unless they conform to the specified Indian Standard and bear the words Self-Declaration - Conforming to IS.

order_title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration Scheme) Order, Phase II
issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
product_scope: Self-ballasted LED lamps, LED controlgear, power banks, cash registers
evidence_excerpt: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services shall conform to IS 16102 (Part 1) and LED controlgear to IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13) under CRS.
